###Finding the area of the whole circle

$\begin{align}
\blueE{\text{Area}_{\text{circle}}} &= \pi \maroonD{r}^2\\\\
&=\pi (\maroonD{10})^2\\\\
&=\blueE{100\pi}
\end{align}$

The area of the whole circle is $\blueE{100\pi\,\text{cm}^2}$.

###Solving for the central angle measure of the sector

We can substitute in the values for the area of the sector and area of the whole circle.

$\begin{align}
\dfrac{ \purpleD{\theta}}{360}&=\dfrac{\goldE{30\pi}}{\blueE{100\pi}}\\\\
\cancel{360}\cdot\dfrac{\purpleD{\theta}}{\cancel{360}}&=\dfrac{\goldE{30\pi}}{\blueE{100\pi}}\cdot 360\\\\
\purpleD{\theta}&=108
\end{align}$

###Solution

The central angle measure of the sector is $108\degree$.
